title: Bear cub dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='26' ry='5' fill='#2a2350'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='85' rx='8' ry='9' fill='#b06a2c'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='85' rx='8' ry='9' fill='#b06a2c'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='88' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#f0b27a'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='88' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#f0b27a'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='20' ry='22' fill='#c97a34'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='12' ry='14' fill='#f0b27a'/>
  <!-- left arm raised up -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='44' rx='7' ry='13' transform='rotate(-35 27 44)' fill='#c97a34'/>
  <ellipse cx='21' cy='34' rx='5' ry='5' fill='#f0b27a'/>
  <!-- right arm raised up -->
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='44' rx='7' ry='13' transform='rotate(35 73 44)' fill='#c97a34'/>
  <ellipse cx='79' cy='34' rx='5' ry='5' fill='#f0b27a'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='22' r='8' fill='#c97a34'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='22' r='4' fill='#f0b27a'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='22' r='8' fill='#c97a34'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='22' r='4' fill='#f0b27a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='19' fill='#c97a34'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#f0b27a'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='28' r='3.2' fill='#3a2410'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='28' r='3.2' fill='#3a2410'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='27' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='27' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='37' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#3a2410'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 42 Q50 47 55 42' stroke='#3a2410' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='36' r='2.5' fill='#e88a6a'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='36' r='2.5' fill='#e88a6a'/>
  <!-- little dance stars -->
  <path d='M18 24 l1.5 3 3 .5 -2.2 2.2 .5 3.2 -2.8-1.6 -2.8 1.6 .5-3.2 -2.2-2.2 3-.5z' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <path d='M82 24 l1.5 3 3 .5 -2.2 2.2 .5 3.2 -2.8-1.6 -2.8 1.6 .5-3.2 -2.2-2.2 3-.5z' fill='#ffe066'/>
</svg>
